newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Rato says stability key after EMU launch.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Rato says stability key after EMU launch.

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Tuesday that stability would be the government's principal macroeconomic objective once the country entered into the common currency.
Rato, in an appearance before a legislative committee on European Union, said that "(The objective of stability) should take precedence when budgets for future years are drawn up."

The as yet undefined Stability Pact is likely to have two major components - one that stipulates multilateral oversight and requires the presentation of national stability plans and another that obliges nations to refrain from excessive deficits.

"This would establish a warning system through which the Commission could detect deviations in the fulfillment of the budgetary objectives by European Union countries and formulate recommendations to ensure those countries adopt timely measures to avoid excessive deficits," Rato said.
